title: Constant-ring pro-etale scalar and open operations and their canonical comparisons
statement: For a scheme $T$ and a commutative ring $A$, write $A_T$ for the constant ring sheaf and use the ordinary unbounded pro-etale module derived operations of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. For a ring map $\varphi:A\to B$ put $S_T=L(-\otimes_{A_T}B_T)$, the derived extension of scalars of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and let $\operatorname{Res}_T:D(B_T)\to D(A_T)$ be termwise restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], with normalized scalar adjunction [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]. For a scheme morphism $f:U\to X$, put $r_A=f_A^{-1}$, the exact constant-ring derived inverse image. Define $\lambda_f:r_B S_X\xrightarrow{\sim}S_U r_A$ to be the inverse scalar-adjunction mate of the identity-on-actions comparison $r_A\operatorname{Res}_X\cong\operatorname{Res}_U r_B$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. If $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], let $e_A=j_!^A$ and $e_B=j_!^B$ be the exact derived open extensions with their open adjunctions [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero]. Define $\beta_j:S_Xe_A\xrightarrow{\sim}e_BS_U$ by uniqueness of left adjoints, comparing $e_A\dashv r_A$ composed with $S_X\dashv\operatorname{Res}_X$ against $S_U\dashv\operatorname{Res}_U$ composed with $e_B\dashv r_B$, using the specified identity-on-actions right-adjoint isomorphism. These definitions apply in particular to finite commutative coefficient rings; no flatness or boundedness is imposed.

    (φ : A →+* B) {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    openExtension j ⋙ scalarExtension φ X ≅
      scalarExtension φ U ⋙ openExtension j
